source_cards.primary_anchor: Fig.1 and introduction: filament orientation and cross-linker roles; Experimental procedures: proteins, buffer and optical traps; Fig.3 and results: parallel-selective fascin binding

conditions.system: Purified human fascin, chicken smooth-muscle alpha-actinin, phalloidin-stabilized actin.
conditions.assay: Four optical traps; 1 micromolar cross-linker for angle tests; 0.1 micromolar for unzipping bundles; actin polymerized with 2 mM ATP in 25 mM KCl, 4 mM MgCl2, pH7.5.
conditions.temperature: Room temperature is stated for bead coating, not a numeric mechanical-assay temperature.

source_cards.observational_unit: Binding of two arranged actin filaments; optical orientation and bundle persistence.
source_cards.finding: Fascin selected parallel filaments, whereas alpha-actinin permitted broader orientations. An explicit 8 nm center-to-center spacing measurement was not located in the inspected main article.
source_cards.limits: The current 8 nm remains SOURCED in the raw declaration but is unregistered. AO04 already inspected this paper for exchange; reinspection is not independent evidence. No spacing prior or bundle-count measurement follows.
source_cards.reported_uncertainty: No error distribution for 8 nm located.

review_snapshot.title: Aratyn 2007 and Courson 2010: exchange depends on pool and competitor context

conditions.system: Aratyn: B16F1 mouse melanoma/N2a neuroblastoma filopodia and reconstituted human fascin bundles. Courson: purified human fascin bundles with phalloidin-stabilized actin.
conditions.temperature: Aratyn specifies 37 C for cellular localization/fraction imaging; the FRAP/FLIP paragraph does not separately state temperature. Courson exchange temperature not located; no 310 K transfer established.
conditions.pool: Courson explicitly contrasts washed-out free fascin with 3 uM added fascin or alpha-actinin.

review_snapshot.observational_unit: Fluorescence recovery/loss of a protein population; not direct survival of every single two-arm crosslink.
review_snapshot.finding: Aratyn Table1 reports off .12/s and on .8/(uM s); FLIP infers about .1/s. Current on 1/s has a different denominator. Courson finds .10 ± .007/s fast exchange with competitor, while buffer-only decay tracks bleaching.
review_snapshot.limits: Rapid protein exchange can coexist with persistent bundles. Mapping to slot attachment/exit requires free concentration, rebinding/avidity and site definition. ~97% inferred bound fraction and 1:25–60 fascin:actin do not calibrate three coarse-node slots. Aratyn appendix acquisition failed; its detailed on-rate derivation was not rechecked.

relations.statement: Builder filament count equals bundle count times strands per bundle. Optical parallel selectivity and imaged roots do not measure either current count or a universal straight-bundle contour.
assumptions: Count boundaries, membrane versus filament-root extent, protein composition and cell state must match.

relations.statement: Root radius=R-clearance-contour; ideal centerline tip radius=R-clearance. Lateral bundle offsets and cell shape affect actual membrane separation. The cap half-angle controls whole-bundle orientation, not internal filament angle.
assumptions: Spherical geometric construction; static code relation only, no membrane-attachment or native clearance validation.

relations.statement: Half of a70° internal branch angle is35° only for a specified symmetric orientation construction. Source filament modes and refined branch geometry are distinct. Current builder alternates independent chains at±mode_angle without mother-daughter junctions.
assumptions: Do not infer branch bonds, rates, density or contour from orientation alone; source load/cell/preparation conditions remain attached.

relations.statement: SF and arc filaments are strands per bundle. SF bundle count derives from basal half-width/pitch; arc count also depends on lift, cell radius, lamellipodial width and packing. Centerline packing is not inter-bundle pitch.
assumptions: Static nonzero-path formulas; current zeros return empty parts. Author-observed focal adhesion topology is not instantiated merely by colocation.

relations.statement: 5000pN/um²=5000Pa=5kPa is a unit conversion. A layer displacement response depends jointly on modulus, thickness, Poisson ratio, support and force length scale. Neither source establishes the current5kPa/50um pair or a universal10um correction cutoff.

source_code_anchors.interpretation: count is number of bundles; filaments is strands per bundle. Straight parallel chains are placed across a cap about +z. cos(polar angle) is distributed across the cap; cap_angle is not the angle between actin filaments. This builder alone supplies no root-to-lamellipodium mechanical bond.

n_filaments is the total chain count. Chains alternate between plus/minus mode_angle about +x; the builder explicitly has no mother-daughter junctions. Orientation modes alone therefore do not establish Arp2/3 branch topology.

filaments is strands per arc, not the number of arcs. Arc count and radii depend on pitch, lift, cell/basal geometry, lamellipodial width and strand packing. n_stations_placed is zero. Placement is not evidence of a focal-adhesion link.

Hexagonal offsets use centerline spacing. filaments is strands per bundle; number of bundles comes from footprint. sarcomere is saved in metadata and n_stations_placed=0; this builder places no periodic myosin or alpha-actinin stations from the sarcomere input.

Conditional geometry: basal half-width=clearance*sqrt(R²-z²)/sqrt(2), SF count=int(2*half/pitch)+1, filopodium root radius=R-tip_clearance-contour. Filopodial centerline tip radius is R-tip_clearance; lateral bundle offsets mean this is not identical to every filament tip distance from the membrane.

Substrate stiffness and thickness are classified declared absent in the suspended specimen, conditional on an adherent preparation. This static metadata is not a verified native substrate implementation.
